<p dir="auto"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" href="/neondatabase/yc-idea-matcher/blob/main/ui.png"><img src="/neondatabase/yc-idea-matcher/raw/main/ui.png" alt="Screenshot of the app UI" style="max-width: 100%;"></a></p>
<p dir="auto">This project allows you Submit your idea and get a list of similar ideas that YCombinator has invested in before.</p>
<p dir="auto">The project is built using the following technologies:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><a href="https://neon.tech" rel="nofollow">Neon</a>: Serverless Postgres</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/pgvector/pgvector">pgvector</a>: open-source Postgres extension for vector storage and similarity search</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/neondatabase/serverless">Neon Serverless Driver</a></li>
<li><a href="https://nextjs.org" rel="nofollow">Next.js</a>: Fullstack framework for React</li>
<li><a href="https://vercel.com" rel="nofollow">Vercel</a>: deployment platform</li>
<li><a href="https://openai.com" rel="nofollow">OpenAI API</a>: generating vector embeddings</li>
<li><a href="https://tailwindcss.com" rel="nofollow">TailwindCSS</a>: Utility-first CSS framework</li>
<li><a href="https://upstash.com" rel="nofollow">Upstash Redis</a>: serverless Redis for rate limiting</li>
<li><a href="https://zod.dev" rel="nofollow">Zod</a>: TypeScript-first schema validation</li>
<li><a href="https://react-query.tanstack.com" rel="nofollow">React Query</a>: data fetching and caching library</li>
<li><a href="https://vaul.emilkowal.ski/" rel="nofollow">Vaul</a>: Drawer component for React.</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">How the app works</h2><a id="user-content-how-the-app-works" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: How the app works" href="#how-the-app-works"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">You will find a script called <code>generate-embeddings.ts</code> located in the root directory of this project. After running <code>npm run generate-embeddings</code>, the script does the following:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>It creates the database schema and installs the <code>pgvector</code> extension</li>
<li>It goes through the YCombinator API '<a href="https://api.ycombinator.com/v0.1/companies?page=1" rel="nofollow">https://api.ycombinator.com/v0.1/companies?page=1</a>' and gets all the companies</li>
<li>For each company it generates embeddings using the long description and then stores the company data in the database.</li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p dir="auto">Some companies don't have a long description, so we needed to manually remove those from the database by running <code>delete from companies WHERE embedding = ARRAY[]::real[];</code></p>
</blockquote>
<p dir="auto">The app itself is a Next.js app with an API route located at <code>/api/idea</code>. Whenever a user submits an idea, the following happens:</p>
<ol dir="auto">
<li>The idea is sent to the OpenAI API to generate an embedding</li>
<li>We then use pgvector to retrieve the top 3 most similar ideas</li>
</ol>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">The UX of ChatGPT in your React app 💬🚀</h2><a id="user-content-the-ux-of-chatgpt-in-your-react-app-" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: The UX of ChatGPT in your React app 💬🚀" href="#the-ux-of-chatgpt-in-your-react-app-"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto"><strong>assistant-ui</strong> is an open source TypeScript/React library to build production-grade AI chat experiences fast.</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>Handles streaming, auto-scrolling, accessibility, and real-time updates for you</li>
<li>Fully composable primitives inspired by shadcn/ui and cmdk — customize every pixel</li>
<li>Works with your stack: AI SDK, LangGraph, Mastra, or any custom backend</li>
<li>Broad model support out of the box (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Perplexity, AWS Bedrock, Azure, Google Gemini, Hugging Face, Fireworks, Cohere, Replicate, Ollama) with easy extension to custom APIs</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Why assistant-ui</h2><a id="user-content-why-assistant-ui" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Why assistant-ui" href="#why-assistant-ui"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Fast to production</strong>: battle-tested primitives, built-in streaming and attachments</li>
<li><strong>Designed for customization</strong>: composable pieces instead of a monolithic widget</li>
<li><strong>Great DX</strong>: sensible defaults, keyboard shortcuts, a11y, and strong TypeScript</li>
<li><strong>Enterprise-ready</strong>: optional chat history and analytics via Assistant Cloud</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Getting Started</h2><a id="user-content-getting-started" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Getting Started" href="#getting-started"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Features</h2><a id="user-content-features" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Features" href="#features"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Build</strong>: composable primitives to create any chat UX (message list, input, thread, toolbar) and a polished shadcn/ui theme you can fully customize.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Ship</strong>: production-ready UX out of the box — streaming, auto-scroll, retries, attachments, markdown and code highlighting — plus keyboard shortcuts and accessibility by default.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Generate</strong>: render tool calls and JSON as components, collect human approvals inline, and enable safe frontend actions.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Integrate</strong>: works with AI SDK, LangGraph, Mastra, or custom backends; broad provider support; optional chat history and analytics via Assistant Cloud (single env var).</p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Backends</h2><a id="user-content-backends" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Backends" href="#backends"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Assistant Cloud</strong>: managed chat persistence and analytics. Deploy with the Cloud Starter template; bring any model/provider.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>AI SDK</strong>: integration with Vercel AI SDK; connect to any supported provider.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>LangGraph</strong>: integration with LangGraph and LangGraph Cloud; connect via LangChain providers.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Mastra</strong>: integration with Mastra agents/workflows/RAG; model routing via Vercel AI SDK; optional Mastra Cloud.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>Custom</strong>: use assistant-ui on top of your own backend/streaming protocol.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Customization</h2><a id="user-content-customization" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Customization" href="#customization"><svg class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">assistant-ui takes a Radix-style approach: instead of a single monolithic chat component, you compose primitives and bring your own styles. We provide a great starter config; you control everything else.</p>
